records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#3
records.source: SPECTRAL UNMIXING COMES FIRST. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control wells ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw field is unmixed across all its channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured channels and unmixes each field before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved run settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.context: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control microplate sample positions ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw microscope field of view is unmixed across all its image data channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured image data channels and unmixes each microscope field of view before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved processing-session settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.translation: DIE SPEKTRALE ENTMISCHUNG KOMMT ZUERST. Bei aktiviertem ``unmix`` wird aus den durch ``unmix_controls`` benannten Kontrollvertiefungen mit Einzelfärbung eine Übersprechmatrix geschätzt. Jedes rohe Bildfeld wird über alle Kanäle entmischt, bevor Beleuchtungskorrektur, PSF und Verarbeitungskette angewendet werden; die Matrix wird demselben Datensatz hinzugefügt. Messen schätzt eine eigene Matrix für die gemessenen Kanäle und entmischt jedes Bildfeld vor seinen Vorverarbeitungsschritten; die Matrix wird in den gespeicherten Laufeinstellungen und in ``measurements/bleed_through.json`` erfasst.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.assay_examples#1
records.source: Replication, Invasion, Recruitment and Host–Pathogen offer published datasets through Load test data. Host–Pathogen contains two real THP-1 RNF213 fields, prepared host/nucleus/vacuole masks and fresh measurements of those fields. Replication and Recruitment contain slices of measured screens. Invasion's images are synthetic and explicitly labelled before downloading. Its masks are Cellpose-SAM segmentations from Mask, and its ground truth describes the objects originally drawn into those images.

records.source: spaCR's own detector is first, the default and always usable. SpotNet and Spotiflow are listed whether or not they can run; when one's environment (or SpotNet's DeepCell token) is missing its row is disabled and its tooltip says which. SpotNet's tooltip states its non-commercial licence either way, because this box is where a person chooses it. A saved Spotiflow choice is kept even while its row is disabled or hidden, so the run receives it and says why it cannot run rather than detecting with another detector.
records.context: spaCR's own detector is first, the default and always usable. SpotNet and Spotiflow are listed whether or not they can run; when one's environment (or SpotNet's DeepCell token) is missing its row is disabled and its tooltip says which. SpotNet's tooltip states its non-commercial licence either way, because this box is where a person chooses it. A saved Spotiflow choice is kept even while its row is disabled or hidden, so the run receives it and says why it cannot run rather than detecting with another detector.
records.translation: Der spaCR-eigene Detektor steht zuerst, ist die Voreinstellung und immer verwendbar. SpotNet und Spotiflow werden unabhängig davon angezeigt, ob sie ausgeführt werden können. Fehlt die jeweilige Umgebung oder das DeepCell-Token von SpotNet, ist die entsprechende Zeile deaktiviert und der Tooltip nennt den Grund. Der Tooltip von SpotNet nennt in beiden Fällen dessen nichtkommerzielle Lizenz, da die Auswahl in diesem Feld erfolgt. Eine gespeicherte Spotiflow-Auswahl bleibt erhalten, selbst wenn die Zeile deaktiviert oder ausgeblendet ist. So erhält der Lauf diese Auswahl und meldet, warum sie nicht ausführbar ist, statt einen anderen Detektor zu verwenden.
